title.en: Meta FAIR Releases e-means: An Algorithm Beating k-means in 10x Fewer Epochs
title.zh: META FAIR发布e-means ：在10倍更少的纪元中击败k-means的算法

summary.en: Meta FAIR’s e-means is a mini-batch k-means replacement shipped in FAISS 1.16.0. It reaches Lloyd’s 25-epoch loss in 1.4 to 2.6 epochs, with 10-45x GPU speedups and no extra hyper…
summary.zh: Meta FAIR的e-means是在FAISS 1.16.0中提供的小批量k-means替代品。它在1.4到2.6个时段内达到了劳埃德的25个时段损失， GPU加速10-45倍，没有额外的超级……

title.en: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
title.zh: Grok Build编码代理泄露了一些机密信息，其中一些属于SpaceXSI

summary.zh: 研究人员发现， 35,000个Grok Build应用程序向所有寻找它们的人开放。

title.en: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
title.zh: OpenAI收购由Sonder创始人创建的旅游创业公司Odessia

summary.en: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.
summary.zh: OpenAI尚未说明其对未来旅行的计划。但Sonder创始人弗朗西斯·戴维森（ Francis Davidson ）是旅游业的知名人物。

summary.en: As espionage targets go, Jensen Huang is perhaps one of the least surprising on Earth. The Nvidia CEO runs one of the world's most valuable companies, controls the in-demand techn…

title.en: Zyphra Releases ZONOS3-Mini: Open-Source TTS With 100M Active Parameters
title.zh: Zyphra发布ZONOS3-Mini ：具有100M有源参数的开源TTS

summary.en: Zyphra released ZONOS3-Mini, an Apache 2.0 text-to-speech model with 800M total and 100M active parameters. It clones voices, steers delivery word by word and runs in real time in…
summary.zh: Zyphra发布了ZONOS3-Mini ，这是一个Apache 2.0文本转语音模型，总共有800米和100米的有源参数。它克隆声音，逐字引导传递，并在……内实时运行

title.en: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
title.zh: 帮助护理人员在日常生活中使用人工智能

summary.en: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.
summary.zh: OpenAI学院正在为美国五个城市的护理人员提供免费的实用ChatGPT研讨会，帮助他们在日常生活中培养实用的人工智能技能。
